# MDD Sim Gateway v1.5.4

## 中文

### v1.5.4 修复

- 修复 [Issue #21](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/21)：线路健康恢复删除旧容器后，
  如果读卡器身份恰好短暂不可见，线路会丢失自动恢复计时并永久停在“需要处理”。现在短暂缓存
  缺失会继续重试，真实拔卡或用户关闭 VoWiFi 仍会停止自动恢复。
- 修复更新范围只能围绕 GitHub 最新 Release 判断的问题。“全部版本”现在更新到获准推送的最新
  版本；“仅主版本”按策略中独立配置的稳定版本 tag 更新，后续补丁不会使其错过目标主版本。
- 修复脱敏支持包仍可能保留代理条目名称、出口节点名称和主机网络地址的问题。v1.5.3 及更早版本
  生成的旧支持包不受此修复影响，分享前仍应人工检查，已经公开的未检查附件应删除或替换。

---

## English

### v1.5.4 fixes

- Fixed [Issue #21](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/21): after health recovery
  removed a failed container, a momentary gap in reader identity could erase its retry timer and
  leave the line permanently requiring attention. Transient cache gaps now remain eligible for
  retry; a real card removal or an operator-disabled VoWiFi switch still cancels recovery.
- Fixed update-scope handling that could only select around GitHub's latest Release. “All versions”
  now reaches the approved latest version, while “main versions only” follows its independently
  configured stable tag and does not miss that target after newer patches are published.
- Fixed redacted support bundles retaining proxy-entry labels, exit-node labels, and host network
  addresses. Older bundles produced by v1.5.3 and earlier are unaffected by this fix and should
  still be reviewed before sharing; remove or replace any unreviewed public attachment.
